name: io.github.Boxxji/cerberus-x402-mcp
title: Cerberus x402 Security MCP Server
description: Pay-per-call Web3 & AI supply-chain security MCP server settled in Base & Arbitrum USDC via x402 EIP-3009 and PayAI.

environmentVariables.name: X402_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: Preferred USDC settlement network ('base' for Base 8453 or 'arbitrum' for Arbitrum One 42161).

environmentVariables.name: X402_PAYER_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional caller-supplied EVM private key used strictly locally to sign EIP-3009 USDC TransferWithAuthorization payloads. Omit for free discovery and HTTP 402 quote mode.

environmentVariables.name: CERBERUS_X402_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Cerberus x402 Cloudflare Worker edge API base URL.
